# Supplier Risk Acceptance

## Purpose

Make material unresolved supplier risk explicit when business use proceeds despite a known gap.

## Requirements

A material acceptance SHOULD identify the gap, business rationale, affected scope, compensating measures, approving authority, review/expiry trigger, and exit or remediation expectations.

Acceptance should not convert a temporary exception into permanent undocumented normality.
